New fashion items just arrived at the warehouse. You check the delivery, scan the barcodes and make sure every product is ready for the next step. You'll then move on to order picking, selecting the right articles based on size, color and quantity, either manually or with the help of automated systems. 
You're also responsible for carefully packing orders, including adding the correct packing slips, labels and packaging materials. Additionally, you handle returns and make sure these products are quickly processed and returned to stock. You work independently, but also coordinate smoothly with other departments. This is a day shift role with occasional weekend work for which you'll receive extra pay.
